name: TextReplace
description: Replace text in your messages. You can find pre-made rules in the #textreplace-rules channel in Vencord's Server

settings.label: Simple Replacements
settings.description: Simple find and replace rules. For example, find 'brb' and replace it with 'be right back'

settings.label: Regex Replacements
settings.description: More powerful replacements using Regular Expressions. This section is for advanced users. If you don't understand it, just ignore it

notes: Rules scoped to others' messages change only how messages are shown to you; messages already on screen update when the channel is re-rendered. Regex rules use JavaScript syntax, translated to PCRE2 (\uXXXX, [^], end-of-input $).
